purpose: Authoritative inventory of Terraform-managed AirlineDemo resources, lifecycle ownership, data and network boundaries, cost allocation, outputs, and identity assignment ownership.

disposableDemo.teardown: May be destroyed by the approved demo teardown after data and recording retention decisions.

externallyOwnedRemoteState.teardown: Must not be destroyed, imported, or changed by disposable demo teardown; platform owner approves its separate cleanup path.

costTagPolicy.directlyTaggedResources: Resources whose Terraform provider schema accepts tags receive the common or bootstrap tag set.

modules.dataBoundary: Private, versioned synthetic evidence blobs only; no workflow-state or runtime-host storage.
modules.networkExposure: Private storage account; public network access disabled and storage firewall defaults to Deny.

modules.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry and diagnostic logs; not evidence content or workflow business state.
modules.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed service endpoints; no application ingress or storage data-plane endpoint is created by this module.

modules.dataBoundary: Application runtime only. The runtime can read case-scoped evidence and call the explicitly assigned AI services; no runtime-host storage is provisioned.
modules.networkExposure: Container App has external ingress restricted to supplied CIDR ranges. Registry uses its Azure data plane with admin credentials disabled. Role assignments and the managed identity have no network endpoint.

modules.dataBoundary: Authoritative workflow, business, and audit state for synthetic demo cases; schema migration is a separate identity boundary.
modules.networkExposure: Public Azure SQL endpoint with the provider's Azure-services firewall rule; authentication is Entra-only and the endpoint remains firewall-restricted.

modules.dataBoundary: Bounded document extraction data plane for case-scoped synthetic evidence.
modules.networkExposure: Public service endpoint with explicit IP network ACLs and default action Deny; local authentication is disabled.

modules.dataBoundary: Governed Azure OpenAI extraction/classification data plane for bounded case-scoped processing; model output cannot choose policy or permissions.
modules.networkExposure: Public service endpoint with explicit IP network ACLs and default action Deny; Azure Services bypass is provider-configured and local authentication is disabled.

modules.dataBoundary: Sensitive Terraform state and blob lease metadata only; no application evidence or workflow data.
modules.networkExposure: State storage has a private blob container and a Deny-by-default firewall limited to approved operator CIDRs. Entra authentication is required and shared keys are disabled.

resources.dataBoundary: Azure resource-group control-plane boundary for disposable demo resources.
resources.networkExposure: No data-plane endpoint.

resources.dataBoundary: Private, versioned synthetic evidence blobs; separate from runtime-host storage.
resources.networkExposure: Private; public network access disabled, shared access keys disabled, firewall default Deny.

resources.dataBoundary: Lifecycle policy for evidence blob versions only.
resources.networkExposure: No data-plane endpoint; applies to the private evidence account.

resources.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry and diagnostic logs.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed endpoint; no public application ingress provisioned.

resources.dataBoundary: Synthetic application telemetry correlated to the Log Analytics workspace.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Monitor managed endpoint; no application ingress provisioned.

resources.dataBoundary: Application image and registry metadata; no admin credentials.
resources.networkExposure: Azure Container Registry data plane; admin authentication is disabled. Network restrictions are governed by the registry service configuration, not by application ingress.

resources.dataBoundary: Container Apps hosting and managed environment metadata.
resources.networkExposure: Hosting environment for the externally restricted Container App; no separate application endpoint.

resources.dataBoundary: ASP.NET Core application runtime; evidence access is through the separate private evidence account.
resources.networkExposure: External ingress enabled on the configured port and restricted by the supplied CIDR allow-list; scale-to-zero, one maximum replica.

resources.dataBoundary: Identity metadata only; used for versioned SQL migrations and not application runtime or deployment credentials.
resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint.

resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact scope is the evidence storage account.

resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact scope is the Document Intelligence account.

resources.dataBoundary: Authoritative workflow, business, and audit state for synthetic demo cases.

resources.networkExposure: No data-plane endpoint.

resources.networkExposure: No network endpoint; exact scope is the state blob container.

nonSecretOutputPolicy.published: Resource IDs, names, public service endpoints, approved deployment names, and identity principal/client IDs needed by separately owned deployment or migration steps.
nonSecretOutputPolicy.runtimeHostStorageAccess: Not provisioned by this root. Evidence access is private and separate: the Container App receives only Storage Blob Data Reader on the evidence storage account, and no runtime-host storage account or host-storage role is created.

identityInventory.name: deployment
identityInventory.minimumScope: Protected state container plus the approved workload infrastructure scope required to create or update only this deployment.

assignments.approval: Platform-owner approval; deployment principal object ID is supplied privately.

assignments.role: Minimum resource-management permissions for this Terraform root
assignments.implementation: Externally supplied deployment authorization; not a workload role assignment
assignments.approval: Tenant/subscription administrator approval required; never reused by runtime or migration.

identityInventory.name: runtime
identityInventory.lifecycle: System-assigned identity created with the Container App and removed with it.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Exactly three resource-scoped data-plane roles: evidence account reader, Document Intelligence user, and Azure OpenAI user.

identityInventory.name: migration
identityInventory.lifecycle: Terraform-managed user-assigned identity retained with the disposable workload until approved teardown.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Only the workload SQL database, for versioned schema migration through the separately supplied SQL Entra administrator path.

assignments.implementation: deployment/sql-migration-procedure.md and the SQL Entra administrator path
assignments.approval: Tenant-level Entra/SQL administrator approval required; not granted by the workload root and not a deployment credential.

identityInventory.name: terraform-state
identityInventory.lifecycle: Independent protected-state access path; state resources outlive disposable demo resources.
identityInventory.minimumScope: Only the private Terraform state blob container, using Entra-authenticated backend access and native blob lease locking.

assignments.approval: Protected-state/platform-owner approval; bootstrap is outside the deployment root.

roleAssignmentImplementation.protectedStateWork: terraform/bootstrap/main.tf supplies the container-scoped Storage Blob Data Contributor assignment for the externally supplied deployment principal.
roleAssignmentImplementation.identityOperatingModelWork: terraform/modules/container-apps/main.tf supplies the three exact resource-scoped runtime assignments and distinct runtime/migration identities.
roleAssignmentImplementation.migrationPermission: The SQL migration assignment is intentionally supplied through the separately owned SQL Entra administrator path documented in deployment/sql-migration-procedure.md; this root does not grant it.
